data.long_meaning: The name Finnegan is derived from the Irish name 'Fionnghann' which means 'fair' or 'handsome'. In Irish folklore, Finnegan is a common name for characters in legends and folktales. In Christianity, there is no specific saint or biblical reference associated with this name. The name Finnegan carries the meaning “Fair or Handsome” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Finnegan usually hope their child will grow to embody fair or handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
